dimensions.assessment: Affects millions of federal employees, military personnel, agricultural workers, veterans, and individuals served by federal programs and nutritional assistance nationwide.

dimensions.assessment: The effects are major and life-changing for federal workers receiving back pay, veterans receiving healthcare and benefits, and agricultural and nutritional program recipients.
dimensions.evidence: This division provides FY2026 appropriations for the Department of Agriculture (USDA), the Food and Drug Administration, and related agencies.

dimensions.assessment: Involves hundreds of billions of dollars in federal appropriations, mandatory payments, loan accounts, and program funding across multiple divisions.
dimensions.evidence: For the payment of compensation benefits to or on behalf of veterans... and, in addition, $246,630,525,000, which shall become available on October 1, 2026

dimensions.assessment: Sweeping legal and governmental changes spanning continuing appropriations, agricultural programs, health extenders, veterans benefits, and legislative branch operations.
dimensions.evidence: Making continuing appropriations and extensions for fiscal year 2026, and for other purposes.

card.summary: H.R. 3944 provides fiscal year 2026 appropriations for federal programs and activities relating to military construction, the Department of Veterans Affairs, agriculture, rural development, the Food and Drug Administration, and the legislative branch. The legislation comprises three regular appropriations acts: the Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2026; the Agriculture, Rural Development, Food and Drug Administration, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2026; and the Legislative Branch Appropriations Act, 2026.

card.summary: S. 2257, the Legislative Branch Appropriations Act, 2026, provides federal funding and sets financial rules for operations within the legislative branch of the U.S. government for fiscal year 2026. The bill covers funding for the Senate, joint congressional committees, the Capitol Police, the Congressional Budget Office, the Architect of the Capitol, the Library of Congress, the Government Publishing Office, and the Government Accountability Office, while excluding House-specific funding.

summary: H.R. 5371, the Continuing Appropriations, Agriculture, Legislative Branch, Military Construction and Veterans Affairs, and Extensions Act, 2026, ends the government shutdown that began on October 1, 2025. It provides temporary funding for most federal agencies through January 30, 2026, full-year funding for specific sectors like agriculture, military construction, and veterans affairs, and extends various expiring federal programs, authorities, and health care flexibilities.

affected_groups.effect: Receives back pay for periods of furlough during the government shutdown and protection against reductions in force through January 30, 2026.
Continues funding for veterans' health care, benefits, memorial services, toxic exposure funds, and specialized programs through full-year appropriations and programmatic extensions.
Funds agricultural research, farm conservation programs, rural development loans, and extends key agricultural authorities.
Extends telehealth flexibilities, specific hospital payments, and health-related grant programs through January 30, 2026.

key_provisions: Ends the government shutdown that began on October 1, 2025, providing continuing appropriations for most federal agencies through January 30, 2026.
Provides full-year fiscal year 2026 appropriations for agriculture, military construction, veterans affairs, and legislative branch programs.
Provides back pay for furloughed federal employees and ratifies obligations incurred during the government shutdown.
Extends agricultural programs, public health programs, and various health-related authorizations through January 30, 2026.
Extends Medicare telehealth flexibilities, low-volume hospital adjustments, and ambulance service add-on payments through January 30, 2026.
Extends numerous Department of Veterans Affairs programs, authorities, and grants through September 30, 2026.
Includes over-the-counter monograph drug user fee amendments and extends related FDA authorities.

summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 5371, the Continuing Appropriations, Agriculture, Legislative Branch, Military Construction and Veterans Affairs, and Extensions Act, 2026, ends the government shutdown that began on October 1, 2025. It provides temporary funding for most federal agencies through January 30, 2026, full-year funding for specific sectors like agriculture, military construction, and veterans affairs, and extends various expiring federal programs, authorities, and health care flexibilities.
summary_detail.significance: The legislation reopens closed federal agencies, ensures continued operation of the federal government through January 30, 2026 (or through the remainder of fiscal year 2026 for specific sectors), and prevents the expiration of critical health, agricultural, and veterans programs.

title: Continuing Appropriations, Agriculture, Legislative Branch, Military Construction and Veterans Affairs, and Extensions Act, 2026
